title: Aquarium
description:
A little Friend for your Minecraft World!
Take well care of them.
body:
# Aquarium

![Fish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d62711317841f12cb3486a8b831039a58c457a.png)

**You can now create an aquarium to catch a little friend.**

**Be careful though! You need to check regularly so the water level stays high!**

# Crafting

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40fa268d020786eeffeaba4a9bdf1137f87e4764.png)

**You can craft the aquarium using sand, red sand or gravel.**

**Right click the item to place it. Right click its hitbox to pick up and left click to drop.**

**You can fill it and remove water using glass bottles. Put it in water to fill it completely.**
